logline: The Paradox of Choice: You think more options give you freedom—but excess choice paralyzes your working memory and breeds buyer remorse. Backed by Sheena Iyengar & Mark Lepper (30% vs 3%).
director_vision: An intimate psychological thriller aesthetic in 3D Editorial Minimalist (Humanized Spatial). Grounding abstract decision theory in tangible physical textures, dramatic directional chiaroscuro, and purposeful camera choreography that mirrors the cognitive trap of The Paradox of Choice.
soundtrack_theme: Analog suspense score anchored at 45Hz sub-bass, Mid/Side vocal pocket ducking, and tactile physical Foley reflecting The Paradox of Choice.

scenes.text: If you have *twenty-four* choices, why did Stanford testing prove you *lose* *ninety* *percent* of your focus and *fail* to decide?
